title: 25 July 1963: Live: Odeon Cinema, Weston-super-Mare
content:
The fourth of six consecutive nights of concerts given by The Beatles at the Odeon Cinema in Weston-super-Mare, a seaside town in Somerset, England, took place on 25 July 1963.

Page last updated: 25 January 2024
